build_TransformerLensSAE: build a TransformerLensSAE model with a specified GPT-2 layer index and activation location
run_get_cache_fwd_and_bwd: run forward and backward passes to capture activation and gradient caches for tokens
run_compute_loss: compute cross-entropy loss between shifted logits and labels for language modeling
run_compute_attribute: compute attribute-based latent tokenization using autoencoder activations and gradients
run_forward: run the TransformerLensSAE forward pass to extract concept attributes from input token IDs
